## NYT::NFlow::TThroughputSpec {#NYT_NFlow_TThroughputSpec}

Source: [yt/yt/flow/library/cpp/common/spec.h]({{source-root}}/yt/yt/flow/library/cpp/common/spec.h)

#|
|| **Parameter** | **Description** ||
|| `warmup_period` | **Type**: [TDuration](./all_yson_structs#TDuration)
**Default value**: `3m`
Per-computation measured window before a scaling decision. Every current job must cover it; capacity need not stay flat. Increase it for long batches or bursty input. ||
|| `minimum_load_share` | **Type**: `double`
**Default value**: `0.25`
Minimum Processed/Capacity ratio for growth and probe evaluation. Does not block shrink. Defaults to 0.25. ||
|| `capacity_change_tolerance` | **Type**: `double`
**Default value**: `0.1`
Relative capacity-change tolerance for probe comparisons and revalidation of ordinary shrink recommendations. Defaults to 0.1. ||
|| `max_retry_warmup_period` | **Type**: [TDuration](./all_yson_structs#TDuration)
**Default value**: `24m`
Maximum warm-up after repeated capacity decreases. Defaults to 24 minutes; never shortens warmup_period. ||
|| `reset_generation` | **Type**: `long`
**Default value**: `0`
Change the number to any other nonnegative value to restart exploration across the pipeline. The exploration growth limit is retained. ||
|| `catch_up_period` | **Type**: [TDuration](./all_yson_structs#TDuration)
**Default value**: `15m`
Desired time to drain excess backlog. Defaults to 15 minutes; resource limits may make actual catch-up slower. ||
|| `scale_down_capacity_reserve` | **Type**: `double`
**Default value**: `2.0`
Capacity reserve relative to the historical steady-demand peak; ordinary reductions also retain this reserve relative to Processed. Defaults to 2. ||
|| `scale_down_interval` | **Type**: [TDuration](./all_yson_structs#TDuration)
**Default value**: `1h`
Minimum interval between pipeline-wide batches of ordinary capacity-surplus reductions. Defaults to one hour; zero disables the delay. Plateau returns and probe rollbacks are not delayed; legacy criterion timing and maximum-proposal arbitration are unchanged. ||
|| `peak_demand_window` | **Type**: [TDuration](./all_yson_structs#TDuration)
**Default value**: `9d`
Retention window for the peak measured steady demand, excluding catch-up. Defaults to nine days. The peak limits downsizing, including normal plateau returns, and survives restarts. It does not trigger growth. ||
|| `normal_backlog_batch_count` | **Type**: `double`
**Default value**: `2.0`
Number of actual batches treated as ordinary backlog rather than catch-up demand. ||
|| `minimum_busy_time_share` | **Type**: `double`
**Default value**: `0.75`
Minimum mean busy-time share for a partition to count as loaded in capacity comparisons. ||
|| `minimum_comparable_partition_share` | **Type**: `double`
**Default value**: `0.75`
Minimum loaded-partition fraction required in both observations to compare capacities. ||
|| `minimum_exploration_load_share` | **Type**: `double`
**Default value**: `0.75`
Minimum Processed/Capacity ratio required to extend the exploration limit with confirmed processing progress. At the limit, the same threshold distinguishes a rate plateau from inconclusive exploration. ||
|| `maximum_output_waiting_share` | **Type**: `double`
**Default value**: `0.25`
Decisions are withheld when the mean output-waiting share reaches this threshold. ||
|| `minimum_growth_factor` | **Type**: `double`
**Default value**: `1.5`
Minimum partition-count multiplier for an admitted growth step. ||
|| `maximum_steady_growth_factor` | **Type**: `double`
**Default value**: `4.0`
Maximum growth multiplier for steady input. Must be at least maximum_catch_up_growth_factor. ||
|| `maximum_catch_up_growth_factor` | **Type**: `double`
**Default value**: `2.0`
Maximum growth multiplier for backlog catch-up. Must be at least minimum_growth_factor. ||
|| `minimum_scaling_effectiveness` | **Type**: `double`
**Default value**: `0.1`
Minimum ratio of relative capacity gain to relative partition-count gain for a successful probe. ||
|| `scale_down_tolerance` | **Type**: `double`
**Default value**: `0.1`
Ordinary shrink requires the current count to exceed the required count by more than this fraction. ||
|| `maximum_scale_down_factor` | **Type**: `int`
**Default value**: `2`
Maximum divisor of the partition count per ordinary shrink; does not limit probe rollbacks or plateau returns. ||
|| `retry_warmup_factor` | **Type**: `int`
**Default value**: `2`
Multiplier applied to the measurement window after rolling back a capacity drop. Repeated rollbacks increase the window again, up to max_retry_warmup_period. ||
